name: Fenlow Vault 82 Original
description: This listing is a fetch-limited pontoon stage listed with deck area 127 square metres, freeboard 395 centimetres, occupancy 47 people. Its remaining stated figures are mooring depth 179 metres, per person set after acceptance, station keeping free drift. Every one of them is quoted from the same six axes the other listings in this category are described on.
